theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ce_compositum_pair
theorems.statement: ∀ (E C : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ C] [IsGalois ℚ C], E ⊓ C = ⊥ → ∀ (g : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E) (a : C ≃ₐ[ℚ] C), ∃! h : ↥(E ⊔ C) ≃ₐ[ℚ] ↥(E ⊔ C), (∀ x : E, h (IntermediateField.inclusion (show E ≤ E ⊔ C from le_sup_left) x) = IntermediateField.inclusion (show E ≤ E ⊔ C from le_sup_left) (g x)) ∧ (∀ y : C, h (IntermediateField.inclusion (show C ≤ E ⊔ C from le_sup_right) y) = IntermediateField.inclusion (show C ≤ E ⊔ C from le_sup_right) (a y))
